title: R’ Abba, Son of Rav Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Rav Chisda at the end of Menachot, though some read Rabbah bar Rav Yitzchak there; see that entry. Under this name he is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:1 together with Rabbi Zeira. Hyman infers from the passage that both studied under Rav Yirmeyah (bar Abba).
